### Observed differences

- In the later window, activity A01 appears in all 200 traces (was absent before) and always at the last position. [OCC001, POS001]
- Activity A05, present in about 46.5% of traces before (mean 0.86 per trace), is absent in all 200 later traces. [OCC002, POS003, DIR002]
- Activity A07, present in all traces in both windows, moved from always last (mean position 1.0) to an earlier position (mean 0.826). [POS004]
- Activity A04's outgoing routing changed: before it went to A05 (46%) and A06 (52%); after it goes to A04 (49%) and A06 (50%), with no A05. [DIR001]
- A07 now always leads to A01 (no outgoing observed before). [DIR003]
- A01 and A04 now co-occur in all traces (before A04 alone), with A04 before A01 in about half and interleaved in half. [REL001]
- A01 and A07 now co-occur with A07 always before A01. [REL003]
- A05 no longer co-occurs with A04 or A07. [REL004, REL005]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports a hypothesis that the process changed from a sequence containing A05 and ending with A07 to a sequence without A05, with A01 added at the end, and A07 moved earlier (before A01). A04 remains but its routing changed (no longer to A05, sometimes to itself). The large number of evidence items (16 vs 0.09 expected) and the consistency across occurrence, position, routing and relation indicators support this. A competing explanation of a rare variant is ruled out by the full presence/absence in the later window.

Other differences: A04's position shifted slightly earlier and its repetition pattern changed (lag 1 appears). [POS002, LAG001] Also A04–A07 distance spread. [LAG002]
